top_findings.title: Non-ASCII title/author is corrupted on create and returned mangled on read
top_findings.evidence: src/books_json.erl:5 decodes via binary_to_list (UTF-8 bytes treated as Latin-1 codepoints), :24 unicode:characters_to_binary re-encodes them; src/books_store.erl:134 sql_string(binary_to_list) is encoded again by open_port args (:97). Second-opinion probe on a temp copy: POST author "García" -> sqlite hex 47617263C383C283C382C2AD61 (expected 47617263C3AD61); response author = 37 bytes <<71,97,114,99,195,131,194,131,...>> vs expected <<71,97,114,99,195,173,97>>
top_findings.suggestion: Decode JSON over UTF-8 (unicode:characters_to_list(Data)) and pass SQL as unicode chars, or use a real JSON lib (jsx/thoas, OTP 27 json) and an SQLite NIF (esqlite) with bound parameters
